name: Chorus Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Volunteer at Kentucky Performing Arts events as part of the chorus volunteer group. The program page does not list the tasks.
who_can_apply: Ages 16 to 23. You must be enrolled in school full time.
duration: Chorus volunteers give 40 hours of service per year.
deadline_text: Volunteer orientation is typically held once a year in late summer or early fall. No application deadline is posted.
how_to_apply: Use the Apply Here link in the Chorus Volunteer Program section of the program page. You will be told about the next orientation.
notes: Call the volunteer office at 502-566-5141 with questions.
